Hi Chloe,

Hope you’re well. ArkBridge is in the final stages of procurement and our security team needs a short interim assurance note covering the period after the report end date on your latest SOC 2 Type II until today.

Specifically, we need:

- A short summary of any compensating controls or mitigations if changes did occur.
- Confirmation of retention/access to relevant audit evidence (logs, change management records) for at least the prior 12 months.

Please note our contract committee expects this before EOD Wednesday so we can finalize terms. I’ve attached ArkBridge’s standard gap checklist for reference.

Confirming: no material control changes since 2026-12-31. Operational changes in Q1 2027 were limited to:
- Expanded S3 lifecycle policy for log retention (no change to access controls)
- Pilot of an alternate metrics exporter in a test cluster (read-only metrics, no PII processed)
- Upgraded our patch orchestration tooling (no change to separation-of-duties controls)

All changes are documented in the attached interim control matrix. No compensating controls beyond the ones already documented were necessary.

If legal wants different wording, let us know, but from an ops perspective we’re good to affirm.

Hi Lena — thanks for the quick turnaround on timing. Per our conversation and internal review, please find below the interim assurance confirmation you requested. I’ve attached the signed one-page confirmation and our interim control matrix for your records.

---BEGIN STATEMENT---
Redwood Inference ("Redwood") confirms that its SOC 2 Type II report with an audit period ending 2026-12-31 remains accurate and that, based on Redwood’s internal compliance reviews through 2027-06-20, Redwood is not aware of any material changes to the design or operating effectiveness of controls covered by that report. Operational adjustments made in Q1/Q2 2027 are documented in the attached interim control matrix and do not constitute material control deviations.

This letter is provided for informational purposes only and is not a substitute for an independent SOC 2 attestation. Redwood does not provide any additional warranties beyond those in any executed agreement between the parties.
---END STATEMENT---
